settings.title: Settings
settings.languageDescription: The UI language. Restart the app to fully apply in all panels.
settings.autostartDescription: Start Parlato automatically when you log in to Windows.

settings.restoreClipboardDescription: Restore your previous clipboard content (images, text, files) after the dictation is pasted.
settings.textFormattingDescription: Apply sentence case, capitalization and punctuation cleanup.
settings.liveTranscriptInfo: Shows live text while recording with realtime models (cloud streaming providers).
settings.liveTranscriptDescription: The recorder pill shows the text as you speak.
settings.appLanguageDescription: Language of the menus and buttons. The language you speak is set in Speech model.
settings.appearanceDescription: Match Windows follows your light or dark mode setting.
settings.trayLabel: Keep running when I close the window
settings.trayHint: Parlato stays in the tray next to the clock. Right-click its icon to quit.
settings.soundsHint: A short sound when recording starts, stops or is cancelled.
settings.muteHint: Mutes music and videos so they don't end up in your text.
settings.resumeHint: How long to wait before unmuting once dictation ends.
settings.liveHint: Only with online models that support live text.
settings.recorderPosHint: Where the little recording bar appears.
settings.formatHint: Adds line breaks and capitalisation to long dictations.
settings.spaceLabel: Add a space after the text
settings.spaceHint: So the next word you type doesn't stick to it.
settings.clipHint: Whatever you had copied (text, images, files) is restored after pasting.
settings.fillersHint: Removes um, uh, hmm and similar.
settings.deleteDictationsHint: History and recordings are stored only on this PC.
settings.keepAudioHint: For replaying and transcribing again from History.
settings.versionHint: Parlato {{version}} for Windows. Updates install the next time Parlato starts.
settings.releaseNotesHint: See what changed in each version.
settings.feedbackHint: Found a bug or have an idea? Opens the project's issue page on GitHub.
settings.madeByLabel: Made by Miguel Monzones, Craft Concepts Digital
settings.madeByHint: Parlato is free. If it saves you time, pass it on to a friend.

welcome.title: Welcome to Parlato
welcome.subtitle: Voice dictation for Windows, local or cloud.
welcome.description: Local and cloud voice dictation for Windows. We will quickly configure the microphone, OCR and keyboard shortcut. It takes less than 2 minutes.

permissions.title: Microphone access
permissions.description: Parlato needs access to your microphone to record your voice. You can manage this in Windows privacy settings.

model.title: Pick a transcription model
model.description: Whisper base is a good default. You can always change it later from the AI Models panel.

hotkey.title: Set your hotkey
hotkey.description: The default is Right Alt. Press and hold to record, release to stop. A short tap enters hands-free mode.

ready.title: You're all set!
ready.description: Press the hotkey and start dictating. Your text will be pasted at the cursor.

step.microphoneDescription: Parlato needs access to your microphone to record your dictation. If no device is detected, open Windows Settings > Privacy > Microphone.
step.ocrDescription: Used to analyze the active window contents and enrich LLM prompts. Install a language pack with OCR in Windows Settings > Time and language > Language.
step.autostartDescription: Launch Parlato when Windows starts, so your hotkey is always available.
step.hotkeyDescription: Parlato listens to a global shortcut to trigger recording. Default: Right Alt (hold or double-tap depending on the mode). You can reconfigure it in Settings.

history.title: History
history.description: Your past dictations. Click the copy icon to grab any text, or Export CSV to save the full log.
history.descriptionFull: Transcription log (local SQLite). Search covers raw and enhanced text.
history.emptyHint: Start a recording and your transcripts will appear here.
history.emptyLong: No transcription. Start a recording to begin.
history.confirmClear: Delete all history? This cannot be undone.
history.retentionHelp: Only one mode active at a time (transcription deletion supersedes audio-only deletion). Runs at startup and every 24h.

sources.localDescription: Whisper models running on your machine. 100% offline.
sources.cloudDescription: Cloud providers for fast transcription. Requires API key.
sources.parakeetDescription: NVIDIA Parakeet TDT via ONNX Runtime. Fast and multilingual.

dictationLanguage.title: Dictation language
dictationLanguage.description: Language used by the active model ({{model}}). Switch to 'Auto-detect' to let the model identify the language at recording time.

import.title: Import Local Model
import.description: Add a custom fine-tuned whisper model (.bin GGML file)
import.infoTip: Add a custom fine-tuned whisper model to use with Parlato. Select the downloaded .bin file.

parakeet.cpuHint: Enable the Cargo feature cuda-onnx (NVIDIA) or directml-onnx (Windows GPU) for acceleration.

llmLocal.nGpuLayersHelp: 0 = CPU, 1000 = all on GPU (if CUDA active)

promptEditor.customDescription: The custom prompt will be used for LLM enhancement of transcriptions.
promptEditor.injectWrapper: Inject into the Transcription Enhancer template
promptEditor.injectWrapperHelp: Uncheck for direct assistant mode (the prompt is used as-is without a wrapper).
promptEditor.triggerWordsHelp: Activate this prompt automatically when the transcript contains one of these words.

powerMode.title: Power Mode
powerMode.description: Automatically activates a profile (prompt + LLM + transcription source) based on the foreground app or URL at record time.
powerMode.autoRestoreDescription: When on, Parlato reapplies the original settings at the end.
powerMode.emptyList: No configurations. Click "New config" to get started.
powerMode.promptAppName: Exe name (without .exe) - e.g.: chrome, code, notepad
powerMode.sheetDescription: Automatically activates a profile (prompt + LLM + source) based on the foreground app or URL.
powerMode.language: Language (whisper code: en, fr, empty for auto)
powerMode.shortcutHint: Shortcut: while recording, hold Alt and press this number to switch to this profile

recorder.title: Recorder
recorder.description: Configure your audio device, hotkey and visualization style.
recorder.recordingDescription: WASAPI 16 kHz mono Int16 capture, triggered by Right Alt (hold for PTT, tap for hands-free mode)

transcribe.title: Local transcription
transcribe.description: Run Whisper on the last recorded WAV with the selected model

postProcessing.title: Text post-processing
postProcessing.description: Filters applied after transcription, before paste at the cursor
postProcessing.formatParagraphsDescription: 50-word chunking, max 4 meaningful sentences per paragraph
postProcessing.removeFillersDescription: Strips uh, um, hm, etc. based on the list below
postProcessing.appendSpaceDescription: Adds ' ' after the pasted text (useful when chaining with other words)
postProcessing.restoreClipboardDescription: Saves and restores the text clipboard around the paste

dictionary.title: Personal dictionary
dictionary.description: Replacements applied after transcription. Variants are comma-separated. Non-spaced scripts (CJK, Thai) use a substring fallback.
dictionary.empty: No entry. Add a first replacement to standardize the output.

permissions.intro: Current state of permissions and system dependencies.

permissions.ocrTip: OCR uses the active Windows language pack. Add the language you want (French, English, etc.) in Windows Settings > Time and language > Language, then download the 'Optional OCR language pack'.

permissions.hotkeyTip: Parlato installs a low-level WH_KEYBOARD_LL hook which does not require special permissions on Windows. The default shortcut is Right Alt.

default.title: Default
default.description: Cleans up the transcription (grammar, fillers, formatting).

assistant.title: Assistant
assistant.description: Assistant mode: direct answer, no markdown.

hotkey.cardDescription: Pick the key (or combination) that activates dictation. Default is Right Alt.
hotkey.altGrTip: On AZERTY/QWERTZ keyboards, AltGr generates a synthetic Right Alt event when you type @, #, {, [, etc. Parlato detects and ignores those automatically.

modeHints.toggle: Press to start, press again to stop. Hands-free dictation.
modeHints.pushToTalk: Hold to record, release to stop.
modeHints.hybrid: Tap (under 500ms) starts a hands-free session. Hold (over 500ms) is push-to-talk.

record.title: Record a custom combination
record.hint: Press the keys you want to use. Need at least one modifier and a final key (e.g. Ctrl + Alt + R, F13, Win + Space). Esc cancels.
record.needsModifier: A standalone key is only allowed for F1-F24, Insert, Delete, Home, End, PageUp/Down, Pause, PrintScreen. Otherwise add Ctrl, Alt, Shift or Win.

additional.cardDescription: Global shortcuts for the last transcription and for cancelling a recording. Not set by default.
additional.copyLastHint: Copies the last transcription (enhanced text if available) to the clipboard. Also available in the tray menu.
additional.retryLastHint: Transcribes the last recording again with the current model and enhancement, then copies the result to the clipboard and adds it to the history.
additional.cancelHint: The assigned shortcut cancels the recording. Resetting restores the default double-Escape behavior.

cloudTimeout.title: Cloud transcription timeout
cloudTimeout.description: Maximum time to wait for a cloud provider to return a transcription. Default 30 seconds.

voice.sameAsWindowsNote: Follows your Windows default. Switches when you plug in a headset.
voice.noDevices: No microphone found. Plug one in, then refresh.
voice.levelHint: Speak normally. The bar should reach about halfway. Too quiet? Move closer or pick another microphone.
voice.shortcutDescription: Your main key. The Default power mode uses it, and other power modes can add their own.
voice.keyHint: Change it any time. Custom lets you record a key combination.
voice.holdDesc: Hold the key while you speak, let go to paste. Best for quick notes.
voice.toggleTitle: Tap to start, tap to stop
voice.hybridDesc: A quick tap goes hands-free, holding works like hold to talk.
voice.secondHint: An extra key that also starts dictation.

pm.emptyDesc: Make one for an app you use a lot, like a formal style for Outlook or notes for Notion.
pm.pickOne: Pick a power mode on the left, or make a new one.
pm.confirmBody: Its paired apps go back to your normal settings. This can't be undone.
pm.startsDesc: Pair apps or websites, or press the mode's shortcut.
pm.shortcutDesc: Switches to this mode for your next dictation.
pm.noShortcut: Only the first 10 modes that are on get a shortcut.
pm.pairedDesc: When you dictate in one of these, this mode is used automatically. No shortcut needed.
pm.fallbackDesc: Used in every app that isn't paired with another power mode.
pm.doesDesc: Anything left on "Keep my usual" uses your normal settings.
pm.speechModelDesc: The engine that turns your voice into text in this mode.
pm.languageDesc: Leave empty to keep your usual language. Use a code like en, fr or es.
pm.aiCleanupDesc: Tidy punctuation and filler words, then apply the writing style below.
pm.styleDesc: Instructions the AI follows. Create new styles in AI cleanup.
pm.screen: Let the AI see the window
pm.autoRestoreDesc: Return to your normal settings once a power mode dictation is done.
pm.shortcutWins: If you press a mode's shortcut, that mode wins over any paired app.

ob.setupDesc: Four quick steps. About two minutes.
ob.later: you can change all of this later in settings
ob.micDesc: Pick your microphone, then press Test and say something out loud. The bar should move.
ob.micSettings: Bar not moving? Open Windows microphone settings
ob.modelTitle: Where should your voice be turned into text?
ob.modelDesc: On this PC is private and free after a one-time download. Online services need an account key. You can change this later in Speech model.
ob.keyDesc: You will press this key whenever you want to talk. Pick one that is comfortable and that you do not use for anything else.
ob.tryDesc: Click in the box, press {{key}}, say a sentence, then let go.

ob.tryNote: Your words appear here when you let go of the key. Nothing is sent anywhere unless you picked an online service.
ob.autostartDesc: So it is ready whenever you want to dictate.

ggml_tiny.name: Tiny (multilingual)
ggml_tiny.notes: Very fast, limited accuracy. Good for trying things out.

ggml_tiny_en.name: Tiny (English)
ggml_tiny_en.notes: English only. A little more accurate than multilingual Tiny for English.

ggml_base.name: Base (multilingual)
ggml_base.notes: Good balance of size and accuracy on a regular processor.

ggml_base_en.name: Base (English)
ggml_base_en.notes: English only. More accurate than multilingual Base for English.

ggml_large_v2.name: Large v2 (multilingual)
ggml_large_v2.notes: Very accurate, but needs a lot of memory.

ggml_large_v3.name: Large v3 (multilingual)
ggml_large_v3.notes: Latest generation and the most accurate. Heavy on the processor.

ggml_large_v3_turbo.notes: Large v3 tuned for speed. Best with a graphics card.

ggml_large_v3_turbo_q5_0.notes: Compressed. Very good quality for its size on a regular processor.

parakeet_tdt_0_6b_v2.name: Parakeet TDT 0.6B v2 (English, F16)
parakeet_tdt_0_6b_v2.notes: The reference model. English only. About 2.5 GB to download.

parakeet_tdt_0_6b_v2_int8.name: Parakeet TDT 0.6B v2 (English, int8)
parakeet_tdt_0_6b_v2_int8.notes: Compressed version. About 680 MB. English only.

parakeet_tdt_0_6b_v3.name: Parakeet TDT 0.6B v3 (multilingual, F16)
parakeet_tdt_0_6b_v3.notes: English and 24 other European languages, and it detects which one you speak. About 2.5 GB.

parakeet_tdt_0_6b_v3_int8.name: Parakeet TDT 0.6B v3 (multilingual, int8)
parakeet_tdt_0_6b_v3_int8.notes: English and 24 other European languages, and it detects which one you speak. About 680 MB.

whisper_large_v3_turbo.notes: Whisper v3 Turbo on Groq's servers. Very fast.

scribe_v1.notes: Transcribes once you finish speaking. General purpose.

scribe_v2.notes: Shows your words live as you speak.

nova_3.notes: Deepgram's main model. Works live or after you speak, and learns your custom words.

nova_3_medical.notes: Tuned for medical vocabulary. English only.

voxtral_mini_latest.notes: Transcribes once you finish speaking. Detects the language on its own.

voxtral_mini_transcribe_realtime_2602.notes: Shows your words live as you speak.

stt_async_v5.notes: Transcribes once you finish speaking. 60 languages.

stt_rt_v5.notes: Shows your words live, one by one, as you speak.

speechmatics_enhanced.notes: Works live or after you speak.

gemini_2_5_pro.notes: Google's general-purpose AI, used here to transcribe.

gemini_2_5_flash.notes: Faster and cheaper than Gemini 2.5 Pro.

grok_stt.notes: xAI's speech-to-text. Works live or after you speak.

ink_2.notes: Live only, and Cartesia's fastest. English only, no automatic language detection.

universal_3_5_pro.notes: AssemblyAI's most accurate model. Can show your words live.

universal_2.notes: Over 90 languages. Faster than Universal-3.5 Pro, but no live words.

qwen2_5_3b_instruct_q4.notes: All-rounder with an excellent quality-to-size ratio.

gemma_2_2b_it_q4.notes: Lightweight and fast on a regular processor.

phi_3_5_mini_instruct_q4.notes: Strong at reasoning and following instructions.

ggml_small.name: Small (multilingual)
ggml_small.notes: Good balance of accuracy and speed on a regular processor.

ggml_small_en.name: Small (English)
ggml_small_en.notes: English only. More accurate than multilingual Small for English.

ggml_medium.name: Medium (multilingual)
ggml_medium.notes: Very accurate, but slower than Large v3 Turbo.

ggml_medium_en.name: Medium (English)
ggml_medium_en.notes: English only. Very accurate for English.

ggml_large_v3_q5_0.name: Large v3 (Q5_0)
ggml_large_v3_q5_0.notes: Compressed Large v3. Nearly the same accuracy at a third of the size.

granite_4_2_3b_q4.notes: IBM's newest small model. Accurate and faithful to what you said.

parakeet_unified_en_0_6b.name: Parakeet Unified EN 0.6B (English, F16)
parakeet_unified_en_0_6b.notes: NVIDIA's newest and most accurate English model. About 2.5 GB. Licensed by NVIDIA Corporation under the NVIDIA Open Model License.

parakeet_unified_en_0_6b_int8.name: Parakeet Unified EN 0.6B (English, int8)
parakeet_unified_en_0_6b_int8.notes: NVIDIA's newest English model, compressed to about 660 MB with the same results in our tests. Licensed by NVIDIA Corporation under the NVIDIA Open Model License.
